nodes.label: Sincronizar Divisas (GitHub Actions workflow)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the manual '⟳ Sincronizar con...' button removed from Actualizar.tsx on 31-jul-2026. Vercel Hobby (this project's free plan) only allows cron jobs once per day, so automation runs here instead of on Vercel: every 30 minutes, all 9 currencies, each step independent (continue-on-error) so one failing source doesn't block the rest.

nodes.label: Sincronizar Titulares (GitHub Actions workflow)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the manual '⟳ Sincronizar (Finnhub)' / '🌐 Traducir pendientes' buttons removed from Titulares.tsx on 31-jul-2026. Vercel Hobby's free plan doesn't allow cron more frequent than daily, so this runs every 10 minutes: fetches new Finnhub headlines and translates any pending ones.

nodes.label: alexopoulos.jpg (headshot photo)
nodes.rationale: Standard corporate headshot: woman in navy blazer with gold lapel pin over white top, smiling, straight-on framing, softly blurred office/glass-building background, portrait aspect ratio, good resolution/sharpness. Nothing visually off — normal usable professional headshot.

nodes.label: andrew-hauser.jpg (headshot photo)
nodes.rationale: Standard corporate headshot: man in navy suit, light blue shirt, purple patterned tie, slight smile, portrait crop, softly blurred neutral background, good resolution and sharp focus. Normal usable professional headshot, nothing off.

nodes.label: anna-breman.jpg (headshot photo)
nodes.rationale: Professional headshot: woman with short blonde hair, magenta/fuchsia top, blurred bright interior background. Crop extends unusually low into the chest/torso (taller vertical framing and larger file dimensions than the other photos in this set), giving a slightly different aspect ratio/composition than the tighter head-and-shoulders crops used elsewhere in the set — worth a quick look to confirm it renders consistently in the UI grid, but image quality itself is good and nothing appears broken.

nodes.label: barkin.jpg (headshot photo)
nodes.rationale: Professional headshot: man in dark suit and light blue shirt, no tie, wire-frame glasses, smiling, blurred light marble/stone background. Composition is off-center (subject positioned left with wide empty negative space to the right, wider landscape-leaning aspect ratio) rather than a centered portrait crop like most others in the set — likely just how the source image was framed by the issuing bank, not corruption, but worth noting as a visual outlier. Per an in-repo code comment (src/data/centralBankers.ts), Barkin has no Wikimedia Commons photo and this image is a self-hosted local copy rather than a hotlink, consistent with what's visible here.

nodes.label: breeden.jpg (headshot photo)
nodes.rationale: Standard corporate headshot: woman with short blonde hair and glasses, navy polka-dot top under a navy jacket, smiling, statue/column-style blurred background, square-ish portrait crop, good resolution. Normal usable professional headshot, nothing off.

nodes.label: bruce-preston.jpg (headshot photo)
nodes.rationale: Man with glasses and a patterned tie photographed against a plain outdoor concrete/brick wall, angled/candid framing rather than a straight-on studio pose, and noticeably lower image quality/sharpness and smaller file size than the other headshots in this set. Reads as a more informal or lower-fidelity photo than typical for an official bio page — worth a QA check on whether a higher-quality official headshot is available.

nodes.label: Carl Hansen headshot photo
nodes.rationale: QA flag: unusually wide 864x466 crop (near 2:1) with the subject pushed to the left third and a large expanse of plain white background filling the right side. Looks like an uncropped wide banner/group-photo crop rather than a standard centered portrait framing used by the other headshots in this set; recommend re-cropping to a tighter, centered portrait for consistency.

nodes.label: Carolyn Hewson headshot photo

nodes.label: Swati Dhingra headshot photo

nodes.label: Marc-Andre Gosselin headshot photo

nodes.label: Hayley Gourley headshot

nodes.label: Jenny Wilkinson headshot

nodes.label: Karen Silk headshot

nodes.label: Philip R. Lane photo
nodes.rationale: QA flag: unlike the other five tight portrait headshots in this set, this is a wider landscape-oriented half-body shot (arms crossed, more of the suit/torso visible, plain wall background) with a generic filename (lane.jpg vs firstname-lastname.jpg pattern used elsewhere). A code comment near this data ('Barkin, Musalem y Lane no tienen foto en Wikimedia Commons; hotlinkear directo al...') indicates this photo is hotlinked from an external source rather than a standard uploaded headshot, consistent with the mismatched crop/framing versus its peers.

nodes.label: logan.jpg (headshot photo)

Good resolution and quality, consistent framing typical of official bio photos. Nothing off for production use.

nodes.label: lombardelli.jpg (headshot photo)

nodes.label: marnie-baker.jpg (headshot photo)
nodes.rationale: Portrait-crop 400x500 corporate headshot: woman with long brown hair, navy blazer over white top, bright blurred office/window background. EXIF indicates source was a high-resolution Canon EOS R5 capture downsized/cropped for web use. Clean professional quality, nothing off.

nodes.label: michele-bullock.jpg (headshot photo)
nodes.rationale: Portrait-crop 400x500 professional headshot: woman with glasses, shoulder-length brown hair, gray blazer over cream blouse, smiling, warm blurred indoor background. Normal, usable professional headshot with nothing off for production use.

nodes.label: musalem.jpg (headshot photo)
nodes.rationale: Landscape-crop 600x400 (3:2) executive portrait: man in dark suit and blue tie, waist-up framing against an ornate formal interior (gold decorative lattice, wood paneling). High production quality (Sony ILCE-7RM4A EXIF), but crop is landscape/wide and waist-up rather than the tight square or portrait headshot crop used for the other bankers in this set (logan, lombardelli, marnie-baker, michele-bullock), which would look visually inconsistent in a uniform grid of profile photos.

nodes.label: paul-conway.jpg (headshot photo)
nodes.rationale: Landscape-crop 1000x666 (3:2) outdoor snapshot rather than a formal studio headshot: balding man wearing a casual red patterned button-up shirt (no suit/tie), photographed outdoors with sky and blurred foliage/coastline background, dim/overcast lighting giving a flatter, less polished look. Both the casual attire and the wide landscape aspect ratio are noticeably mismatched with the other, more formal square/portrait studio headshots in this set (logan, lombardelli, marnie-baker, michele-bullock, musalem) — flagged for QA review as inconsistent with the rest of the Banqueros profile photo set.

nodes.label: paulson.jpg (Anna Paulson headshot)

nodes.label: pill.jpg (Huw Pill headshot)
nodes.rationale: Portrait-oriented, formal corporate headshot/bust shot in suit and tie, blurred grand interior background with framed painting visible. Good quality, usable as-is.

nodes.label: prasanna-gai.jpg (Prasanna Gai headshot)
nodes.rationale: Landscape/wide crop rather than the tight square/portrait crop used by most other banker photos, smaller file size and noticeably lower resolution/softer than peers, background shows blurred office glass and foliage. Usable but visibly lower quality and inconsistent aspect ratio vs. the rest of the set — worth a QA look.

nodes.label: renee-fry-mckibbin.jpg (Renée Fry-McKibbin headshot)

nodes.label: rogers.jpg (Carolyn Rogers headshot)

nodes.label: snb-martin.jpg (Antoine Martin headshot)
nodes.rationale: Grayscale/black-and-white studio headshot with gradient backdrop, formal suit and patterned tie, sharp and high resolution. Photo itself is clean and usable, but it is the only monochrome image in this set — a stylistic mismatch against the other color headshots that may be worth normalizing for visual consistency.

nodes.label: Banker Headshot: snb-tschudin.jpg
nodes.rationale: Black-and-white studio headshot of a woman with shoulder-length wavy hair, dark blazer over white collared shirt, gradient charcoal background, centered portrait crop. Filename ('snb-tschudin') suggests a Swiss National Bank official named Tschudin. QA note: this photo is monochrome while the other banker photo (vincent.jpg) is full color, so the two headshots are visually inconsistent in treatment across the app; no corruption, placeholder, or orientation issues detected — image renders correctly and crop/framing look intentional and professional.

nodes.label: Banker Headshot: vincent.jpg
nodes.rationale: Color corporate headshot of a man in a navy suit, white shirt, dark tie, softly blurred blue-toned glass-office background, centered near-square crop, good lighting and resolution. QA note: color treatment differs from snb-tschudin.jpg (black-and-white), creating a style mismatch between the two banker photos used in the same UI; no broken file, placeholder artifact, or orientation problem observed.

nodes.label: Favicon (HC monogram mark)
nodes.rationale: Small square icon showing an interlocking gold-and-navy 'HC' monogram (Hikman Capital) on a transparent background. The H incorporates a Venezuelan-flag-like yellow/blue/red patterned texture, and the C is formed from a gold globe/map motif with an upward trending arrow and bar-chart bars woven through it, evoking finance/growth themes. Brand consistency check: visually appears to be the same mark as logo-icon.png, just rendered/exported at a smaller icon size.

nodes.label: UI Icon Sprite Sheet (icons.svg)
nodes.rationale: SVG <symbol> sprite sheet defining 6 distinguishable icons for reuse via <use>: 'bluesky-icon' (Bluesky butterfly logo), 'discord-icon' (Discord game controller/mask logo), 'documentation-icon' (open book/document outline, purple stroke #aa3bff), 'github-icon' (GitHub Octocat-style cat silhouette), 'social-icon' (two overlapping person/profile circles with a badge, purple stroke), and 'x-icon' (X/Twitter logo). These are social-links/footer/external-link and documentation icons rather than chart icons, and most likely correspond to a footer or navigation area of the app UI (e.g. links to socials and docs) rather than to data-visualization charts.

nodes.label: Full Logo Lockup (HC mark + 'HIKMAN CAPITAL' wordmark)
nodes.rationale: Full brand lockup: the same gold/navy interlocking 'HC' monogram (with Venezuela-flag-textured H, globe/arrow/chart-bar C) stacked above the wordmark 'HIKMAN CAPITAL' set in navy blue bold sans-serif caps, on a transparent background. Notably the wordmark reads 'HIKMAN CAPITAL', not 'HIKMAN ENDÓGENO' — a possible brand-naming inconsistency worth flagging for review versus the app name given in the task brief.
nodes.norm_label: full logo lockup (hc mark + 'hikman capital' wordmark)

nodes.label: Logo Icon (HC monogram mark, standalone)
nodes.rationale: Standalone gold-and-navy interlocking 'HC' monogram mark (no wordmark), transparent background, same design (Venezuela-flag-textured H, globe/upward-arrow/bar-chart C) as favicon.png and the icon portion of logo-full.png, rendered at a larger/higher-resolution size. Brand consistency check: this and favicon.png appear to be the identical mark at different export sizes.
